0.why: ChowTapeCompression.cpp process(): float x = inputs[AUDIO_INPUT].getVoltage() / 5.0f, no channel argument

comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, doc/manual.md, and the maker's own ChowTape plugin manual at chowdsp.com, which is where the description of the amount control comes from. The attack and release times are exact: attack is 160000/9801 raised to the knob, times 9801/3010, minus 950/301, which is 0.1ms at the bottom and 50ms at the top; release is 100 raised to the knob times 10, which is 10ms to 1000ms. Both default to the middle of their knob, about 3.6ms and 100ms. The signal is divided by five before the level is measured and multiplied by five again on the way out, so the compression threshold is referred to a 5V peak.
